functions.name: POWER

functions.name: SQRT

functions.name: DATEDIFF

functions.name: YEAR

functions.name: MONTH
functions.description: Extract month from date.

functions.name: DAY
functions.description: Extract day from date.

functions.name: TODAY
functions.description: Current date.

functions.name: NOW
functions.description: Current timestamp.

functions.name: CAST
functions.description: Cast value to a different type.

functions.name: TRY_CAST
functions.description: Cast value, returning NULL on failure.

functions.name: REPLACE
functions.description: Replace occurrences of pattern in text with another value.

functions.name: IFNULL
functions.description: The value, or the fallback where the value is NULL (pandas fillna).

functions.name: GREATEST
functions.description: The largest of the arguments (any number of them).

functions.name: LEAST
functions.description: The smallest of the arguments (any number of them).

functions.name: PREV
functions.description: The value from the row before (or `rows` rows before), in the table's order; NULL on the first row.

functions.name: NEXT
functions.description: The value from the row after (or `rows` rows after), in the table's order; NULL on the last row.

functions.name: SPLIT_PART
functions.description: The index-th piece (from 1) of text split by the separator.

functions.name: SUBSTR
functions.description: Part of the text from position start (from 1), optionally of a given length.

functions.name: LEFT
functions.description: The first count characters.

functions.name: RIGHT
functions.description: The last count characters.

functions.name: LPAD
functions.description: Pad text on the left with fill up to length characters.

functions.name: RPAD
functions.description: Pad text on the right with fill up to length characters.

functions.name: REVERSE
functions.description: The text backwards.

functions.name: REGEX_EXTRACT
functions.description: The part of the text matching a regular expression, or one of its groups (pandas str.extract).

functions.name: REGEX_MATCH
functions.description: True where the text contains a match of the regular expression.

functions.name: STRFTIME
functions.description: Format a date or timestamp as text, e.g. '%Y-%m' or '%d.%m.%Y'.

functions.name: STRPTIME
functions.description: Parse text into a timestamp with a format such as '%d.%m.%Y'.

functions.name: QUARTER
functions.description: Quarter of the year (1-4).

functions.name: WEEK
functions.description: ISO week of the year (1-53).

functions.name: DAYOFWEEK
functions.description: Day of the week, 0 = Sunday to 6 = Saturday.

functions.name: MINUTE
functions.description: Minute (0-59).

functions.name: DATE_TRUNC
functions.description: Round a date down to the start of its 'year', 'quarter', 'month', 'week', 'day' or 'hour' (pandas dt.floor).

functions.name: LN
functions.description: Natural logarithm.

functions.name: LOG10
functions.description: Base-10 logarithm.

functions.name: EXP
functions.description: e raised to the value.

functions.name: MOD
functions.description: Remainder of a division.

functions.name: SIGN
functions.description: -1, 0 or 1 by the sign of the value.

functions.name: DROP_DUPLICATES
functions.description: Remove duplicate rows based on column subset.

functions.name: DROP_NULL
functions.description: Drop rows where a column equals the null sentinel. With no sentinel, drops SQL NULLs. With a sentinel value, drops only rows whose column equals that value (real NULLs are kept).

functions.name: LTRIM
functions.description: Remove leading whitespace.

functions.name: RTRIM
functions.description: Remove trailing whitespace.

functions.name: STRIP_ACCENTS
functions.description: Remove accents: Ş becomes S, é becomes e.

functions.name: CONCAT_WS
functions.description: Join values with a separator, skipping empty ones.

functions.name: POSITION
functions.description: Position of the first occurrence (1 is the first character; 0 when absent).

functions.name: TRY_STRPTIME
functions.description: Parse text with a format such as '%d.%m.%Y'; empty when it doesn't match.

functions.name: MONTHNAME
functions.description: English name of the month.

functions.name: DAYNAME
functions.description: English name of the day.

functions.name: LAST_DAY
functions.description: Last day of the month.

functions.name: EPOCH
functions.description: Seconds since 1970-01-01 (Unix time).

functions.name: JSON_EXTRACT

functions.name: JSON_EXTRACT_STRING
functions.description: The value at a JSON path, as text.

functions.name: ROUNDDOWN

functions.name: TRUNC
functions.description: Cuts off the decimals after `digits` (towards zero).

functions.name: MROUND
functions.description: Rounds to the nearest multiple.

functions.name: INT
functions.description: Rounds down to the whole number below.

functions.name: CEILING
functions.description: Rounds up to a multiple of `significance`.

functions.name: FLOOR.MATH
functions.description: Rounds down to a multiple of `significance` (Excel's FLOOR(number, significance) means the same).

functions.name: LOG
functions.description: Logarithm in `base` (10 by default).

functions.name: PI
functions.description: The number π.

functions.name: QUOTIENT
functions.description: The whole-number part of a division.

functions.name: PRODUCT
functions.description: Multiplies its arguments (a range like [a:c] counts as its columns).

functions.name: RAND
functions.description: A random number from 0 to 1 (new each time the table is read).

functions.name: RANDBETWEEN
functions.description: A random whole number from `bottom` to `top` (new each time the table is read).

functions.name: AVERAGE
functions.description: The column's average (same as AVG).

functions.name: COUNTA
functions.description: How many values the column has (empty ones left out).

functions.name: COUNTBLANK
functions.description: How many values of the column are empty.

functions.name: MEDIAN
functions.description: The column's median (middle value).

functions.name: MODE
functions.description: The column's most frequent value.

functions.name: MODE.SNGL
functions.description: The column's most frequent value.

functions.name: STDEV
functions.description: The column's standard deviation (sample).

functions.name: STDEV.S
functions.description: The column's standard deviation (sample).

functions.name: STDEV.P
functions.description: The column's standard deviation (whole population).

functions.name: VAR
functions.description: The column's variance (sample).

functions.name: VAR.S
functions.description: The column's variance (sample).

functions.name: VAR.P
functions.description: The column's variance (whole population).

functions.name: LARGE
functions.description: The k-th largest value of the column.

functions.name: SMALL
functions.description: The k-th smallest value of the column.

functions.name: PERCENTILE
functions.description: The column's k-th percentile, k from 0 to 1.

functions.name: PERCENTILE.INC
functions.description: The column's k-th percentile, k from 0 to 1.

functions.name: QUARTILE
functions.description: The column's quartile: 0 minimum, 1, 2 (median), 3, 4 maximum.

functions.name: QUARTILE.INC
functions.description: The column's quartile: 0 minimum, 1, 2 (median), 3, 4 maximum.

functions.name: CORREL
functions.description: The correlation of two columns (-1 to 1).

functions.name: SUMPRODUCT
functions.description: Multiplies the columns row by row and adds it all up: the column total of the products.

functions.name: COUNTIF
functions.description: How many rows meet the criteria: a value ('North', 5) or a comparison ('>10', '<>0', '>=2024-01-01'); * and ? are wildcards. With a column of this row, e.g. COUNTIF([region], [region]), it counts the rows like this one.

functions.name: COUNTIFS
functions.description: How many rows meet every criteria (pairs of range and criteria).

functions.name: SUMIF
functions.description: The total of `sum_range` (or `range`) over the rows that meet the criteria.

functions.name: SUMIFS
functions.description: The total of `sum_range` over the rows that meet every criteria.

functions.name: AVERAGEIF
functions.description: The average of `average_range` (or `range`) over the rows that meet the criteria.

functions.name: AVERAGEIFS
functions.description: The average of `average_range` over the rows that meet every criteria.

functions.name: MAXIFS
functions.description: The largest `max_range` value among the rows that meet every criteria.

functions.name: MINIFS
functions.description: The smallest `min_range` value among the rows that meet every criteria.

functions.name: XLOOKUP
functions.description: Finds `lookup_value` in a column of another table and returns the same row's value from another column; `if_not_found` (or empty) when there is no match.

functions.name: VLOOKUP
functions.description: Finds `lookup_value` in the first column of a range of another table (prices[id:price]) and returns column `column_number` of that row. Exact matches only.

functions.name: TEXT

functions.description: TRUE when the value is empty (NULL or empty text).

functions.name: ISNUMBER
functions.description: TRUE when the value is a number (not text that looks like one).

functions.name: ISTEXT
functions.description: TRUE when the value is text.

functions.name: ISEVEN
functions.description: TRUE for even numbers.

functions.name: ISODD
functions.description: TRUE for odd numbers.

functions.name: NA
functions.description: An empty value (Excel's #N/A).

functions.name: IFERROR
functions.description: `value`, or `value_if_error` when it fails (bad conversion, division by zero) or is empty.

functions.name: IFNA
functions.description: `value`, or `value_if_na` when it is empty.

functions.name: NOT
functions.description: Reverses TRUE and FALSE.

functions.name: IFS
functions.description: The value of the first condition that is TRUE; empty when none is. Pairs of condition, value.

functions.name: SWITCH
functions.description: Compares `expression` with each value and returns the matching result; an odd last argument is the default.

functions.name: CHOOSE
functions.description: The value at position `index` (1, 2, …).

functions.name: AND
functions.description: TRUE when every argument is TRUE.

functions.name: OR
functions.description: TRUE when any argument is TRUE.

functions.name: XOR
functions.description: TRUE when an odd number of arguments is TRUE.

functions.name: MID
functions.description: `length` characters starting at position `start` (1 is the first).

functions.name: FIND
functions.description: Position of `find_text` in `within_text` (case-sensitive); empty when not found.

functions.name: SEARCH
functions.description: Position of `find_text` in `within_text`, ignoring case; empty when not found.

functions.name: SUBSTITUTE
functions.description: Replaces every `old_text` with `new_text`.

functions.name: PROPER
functions.description: Capitalises the first letter of each word.

functions.name: CLEAN
functions.description: Removes non-printable characters (line breaks, tabs…).

functions.name: CONCATENATE
functions.description: Joins texts (empty values count as empty text).

functions.name: TEXTJOIN
functions.description: Joins texts with `delimiter`, skipping empty ones when `ignore_empty` is TRUE. A range [a:c] counts as its columns.

functions.name: VALUE
functions.description: The number in a text (thousands commas allowed); empty when it isn't one.

functions.name: REPT
functions.description: Repeats `text`.

functions.name: EXACT
functions.description: TRUE when both texts are exactly equal, case included.

functions.name: TEXTBEFORE
functions.description: The text before the first `delimiter`; empty when there is none.

functions.name: TEXTAFTER
functions.description: The text after the first `delimiter`; empty when there is none.

functions.name: TIME
functions.description: The time of day.

functions.name: SECOND
functions.description: The seconds (0–59).

functions.name: WEEKDAY
functions.description: The day of the week: 1 (Sunday) to 7 by default; type 2: 1 (Monday) to 7; type 3: 0 (Monday) to 6.

functions.name: WEEKNUM

functions.name: ISOWEEKNUM
functions.description: The ISO week of the year (weeks start on Monday).

functions.name: EDATE
functions.description: The date `months` months later (earlier when negative); 31 January + 1 is 28 or 29 February.

functions.name: EOMONTH
functions.description: The last day of the month, `months` months later.

functions.name: DATEDIF
functions.description: Complete years ("Y"), months ("M") or days ("D") between two dates; "MD" and "YM" give the days or months left over.

functions.name: DAYS
functions.description: Days from `start_date` to `end_date`.

functions.name: NETWORKDAYS
functions.description: Working days (Monday to Friday) from `start_date` to `end_date`, both included.

functions.name: YEARFRAC
functions.description: The fraction of a year between two dates (30/360, Excel's default basis).

functions.name: DATEVALUE
functions.description: The date in a text like 2024-03-31; empty when it isn't one.
